name: etix-mcp
description: Etix event discovery for Claude — search events, venues & performers and fetch event details

ws_port.title: Bridge WebSocket port (optional)
ws_port.description: Optional. Override the fetchproxy WebSocket port (default 37149, the shared fleet port). Leave blank for the default.

debug.title: Debug logging (optional)
debug.description: Optional. Set to 1 for stderr per-request bridge timing.

fetchproxy_ws_host.title: Bridge bind interface (optional, hosted only)
fetchproxy_ws_host.description: Optional. Bind interface for the bridge (default 127.0.0.1; a literal IP only, anything else is ignored). Keep on loopback — it exists for ONE topology: a hosted child in its own network namespace. Leave blank.

fetchproxy_identity_dir.title: Bridge identity directory (optional, hosted only)
fetchproxy_identity_dir.description: Optional. Where to store the long-term fetchproxy identity keypair (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/; an absolute path only, anything else is ignored). Exists for a host that runs a separate child per caller, so they can share one identity. Leave blank.

tools.name: etix_search
tools.description: Search Etix events, venues, and performers by keyword

tools.name: etix_get_event
tools.description: Fetch an Etix event/performance's details by event id

tools.name: etix_get_venue
tools.description: Fetch an Etix venue and its upcoming events by venue id

tools.name: etix_find_location
tools.description: Resolve a city or postal code to coordinates for location-based browsing

tools.name: etix_healthcheck
tools.description: Verify the ContextMint Bridge connection end-to-end — no auth required
